properties.description: The one place an export document becomes a file on disk, shared by the export_graph tool and the server's write-through. Holds the four things both callers must agree on: where the lineage anchors, whether the write would drop design the file already holds, what `wrote` reports, and recording that this seat is in step. Extracted because a second copy that drifts is the failure this project keeps meeting — the version guard, the unknown-field interception and the adjacency memo were all that shape.
properties.name: export_write.rs
